raw: van den Berg R. Shoulder Injury

commentary.text: 90+6' Felix Zwayer is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' It's like he was asking for a caution. Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) receives a yellow card.
90+4' The FC Koln players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90' Bernardo comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for FC Koln.

88' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
88' FC Koln control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
84' Lukas Kwasniok has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln) replacing Isak Johannesson.
84' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln) comes onto the pitch so that Kristoffer Lund can be given a rest.
82' The Hoffenheim players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
80' FC Koln string together a series of short passes.
79' Fouls committed – 14:3.
76' The attendance is 30150.
73' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. FC Koln will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' Neat passing move from FC Koln in order to create new attacking opportunities.
72' That will be all from Dominique Heintz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Said El Mala departs the field of play to be replaced by Linton Maina (1. FC Koln).
70' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Muhammed Damar will be replaced by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
70' Substitution. Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) has come on for Fisnik Asllani.
69' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to FC Koln.
68' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the top right corner, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.
67' The corner is swung in but Hoffenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Hoffenheim work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
65' Christian Ilzer has decided to substitute Tim Lemperle and he is replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
65' Substitution. Leon Avdullahu leaves the pitch and is replaced by Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim).

64' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Oliver Baumann makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
62' Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
60' 62:38 – the latest ball possession ratio.
58' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

56' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln will have a goal kick.
56' It will be a corner kick for Hoffenheim.
55' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
53' FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
53' A cross into the box from Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) is cleared.
51' Hoffenheim earn a corner.

50' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
49' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
47' Great teamplay by Hoffenheim as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' A substitution has been made. Jan Thielmann is replaced by Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Felix Zwayer has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Decent spell from Hoffenheim here and they keep the pressure on until one of the defending players steps in. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Hoffenheim.

45+2' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Marvin Schwabe makes a great save to stop his effort.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

45' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
45' Hoffenheim will take a corner kick.
44' FC Koln exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.
43' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Hoffenheim players are visibly unhappy with the call.
43' Referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Hoffenheim. Let’s see what happens!
42' Handball! A player from FC Koln handled the ball. PENALTY! One of the players from Hoffenheim is about to take a penalty kick.

41' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
40' FC Koln enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. FC Koln have a free kick.
36' Hoffenheim seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
36' Some neat passing and movement from FC Koln as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
33' Hoffenheim are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
28' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
27' Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
24' Hoffenheim hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
20' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
20' FC Koln keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
19' The percentage of ball possession is – 57:43.

16' 0 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball low into the middle of the goal and makes it 0:1. Oliver Baumann was helpless.
14' Hoffenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
14' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
13' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
11' That's a free kick to FC Koln.
10' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Felix Zwayer had an easy-decision to make.
10' The ball goes out of play. FC Koln are awarded a corner kick.
9' The FC Koln players are exchanging some short passes.

6' Well-positioned Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Marvin Schwabe reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Hoffenheim.
3' FC Koln are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
2' Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
